regional_gradient_finding: Across the five states with statewide LANDIS trajectories, the year-100 calibrated-over-literature carbon ratio matches each state median ANPP multiplier within 0.05; three regimes confirmed (West cuts about 3x, Great Lakes cut 1.5 to 1.7x, Northeast lifts 32 percent).

methodology.novel_finding: Three-mode calibration degeneracy pathology (active-growth, empty-aggregator, sample-size)

pathology_taxonomy.active_growth: very low theta -> near-zero growth -> trivial IC fit; guard: active-growth fraction >= 0.50
pathology_taxonomy.empty_aggregator: per-plot pipeline failure -> empty per_plot.csv -> LL=0 default; guard: non-empty per_plot.csv
pathology_taxonomy.sample_size: few successful pairs -> trivially small LL magnitude -> CMA-ES misled; guard: MIN_N_PAIRS >= 300, harvester uses per-plot LL on near-full-n candidates
